_description: Default concordance mapping WIOD National IO Table (NIOT nov16) sector codes to ABM model sectors. NIOT uses actual ISIC Rev.4 codes (A01, B, C10-C12, ...) rather than the sequential C01-C56 codes of the global WIOT. Assign each NIOT code to exactly one model sector; codes not listed are dropped. Adjust for your application region and research question.
